description: Get status/details of the selected Amazon seller account (outpost), including the Amazon Ads connection: ads.ads_status and, for Ads consents granted from 30/7/2026, ads.expires_at / ads.days_left (Amazon expires Ads consent 365 days after it is granted, then Ads stop working until the seller reconnects). If ads.warning is present, tell the user and point them to Marketplaces → Reconnect Ads.

account_id.description: ID dell'outpost Amazon (= un seller su uno specifico marketplace; vedi list_clients). Opzionale se il token è legato a un solo outpost.

name: get_client_status
